en.summary: The Lukashenko government drafted the 2027 budget and outlook around meeting the 2026-2030 five-year plan. PM Turchin's cabinet prioritises building up to 5,000km of roads a year, more rental housing, faster large investment projects and regional investment lending (tourism, robotics, food). EU, US and UK sanctions remain.
en.leader: President Alexander Lukashenko / Prime Minister Aleksandr Turchin
agenda: Meet the 2026-2030 five-year plan targets
Build up to 5,000km of roads a year
More rental housing
Speed up major investment projects (Decree No. 266)
Regional investment lending (tourism, robotics, dairy, meat)
